sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A shrub or tree native to southeastern Bahia, Brazil, in the wet tropical biome. Kew currently accepts the name Jupunba turbinata; Abarema turbinata is a synonym. A verified species-specific height or crown width was not located.

sections.title: Uses and safety
sections.text: Edibility, toxicity and other human uses were not verified in the sources consulted.
